verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT's compute stack, ROCm, ships as explicitly versioned SDK releases (ROCm 7.2.1, Core SDK 7.14.0, ROCm 10.0.0). It also has a compatibility matrix and a transition guide for moving off the legacy release stream, and hipBLAS documents an interface that needs no client changes when the backend changes. No deprecation policy, deprecation timelines or API stability guarantees appear in the evidence. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, API stability/compatibility guarantees across versions, deprecation notice timelines, independent corroboration.
